name: 9:16 Band + title (rp.profits style)
notes: Keeps the source 16:9 frame WHOLE — including any webcam inset it already has — and sets it as a band on a black canvas, with the title plate in the space above. This is the rp.profits treatment: deliberate negative space rather than a filled frame. A 1080-wide 16:9 band is 608px tall, so videoY is the band's top edge on the 1920 canvas.
